title: fix(plugin-form): the master-detail form's Subtotal / Tax / Total show the amount field's currency, not a hard-coded ¥ (objectui#11132)
body:
Fixes #11132

Clause-②: no
Why no (carried from the claim, comment 5897361654): a display sign follows the field's resolved currency. No schema, prop, type or accepted set moves.

Dispatched implementation, `domain:ui` seat 2, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`. Draft until the seat lands it. Direction: triage comment 5896646901.

## What changed

`MasterDetailForm`'s document totals stack (Subtotal / Tax / Total, test ids `md-subtotal`, `md-tax`, `md-grand-total`) built every line as a literal `¥` followed by the display-locale digits at two places, whatever the amount field's or the tenant's currency.

- **Currency.** The stack now resolves its currency through `resolveFieldCurrency` (`@object-ui/i18n`) on the entry's amount field definition, with the tenant default (`useLocalization().currency`, ADR-0053) as the resolver's last step. No constant, no second resolver.
- **Where the field definition comes from.** The child object's own field, read from the schema the resolve effect already fetches to derive or hydrate the entry's columns. It is kept on the internal `DetailEntry` record as `amountFieldDef`; the authored `MasterDetailDetailConfig` is untouched.
- **Format.** `formatDisplayNumber(n, { locale, currency })`: `Intl`'s currency style in the display locale. The sign sits where the locale puts it, and the width is the currency's ISO 4217 minor unit, which is `Intl`'s default for `style: 'currency'`.
- **No currency known.** A plain number at the historical two places (also `CurrencyField`'s no-currency width), no sign.
- **Several entries.** One sign only when every entry with an amount field resolves to the same code. When they differ, plain numbers: the resolver's own answer for an amount whose currency is not known. See open question 1 in the report.
- **A code `Intl` refuses.** The code beside the plain number, digits still in the display locale, instead of a thrown `RangeError` taking the form down.

## Measured: which formatter the currency faces use

Two formatters exist in the family, both reading `resolveFieldCurrency`:

1. `formatCurrency` (`@object-ui/fields` entry): `CurrencyCellRenderer`, the grid summary footer (`useColumnSummary`) and the metric tile. A whole amount drops its fraction (`$1,234`).
2. `formatDisplayNumber` with `currency` and the currency's minor unit on both bounds: `CurrencyField` (`formatAmount`) and `GridField`'s currency cells (`currencyText`). Those grid cells are the line items directly above this stack.

The stack takes the second. It agrees with the line cells above it by construction and keeps the stack's own always-show-the-fraction form. With the first, a whole subtotal would read `$1,000` under line cells reading `$1,000.00`.

`currencyFractionDigits` is not on the `@object-ui/fields` package entry (its `index.tsx` re-exports only `resolveFieldCurrency` and `formatCurrency` from `currency.ts`), so the stack does not pass a width. `Intl`'s default for `style: 'currency'` is the same minor unit that helper reads: `resolvedOptions()` for JPY answers 0 / 0, and 1234.5 formats as `$1,234.50` (en, USD), `1.234,50 $` (de-DE, USD), `¥1,235` (en, JPY), `KWD 1,234.500` (en, KWD).

## What a reader sees change

| Tenant / field | Locale | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD tenant | en | `¥1,234.50` | `$1,234.50` |
| USD tenant | de-DE | `¥1.234,50` | `1.234,50 $` |
| JPY tenant | en | `¥1,234.50` | `¥1,235` (width 2 becomes 0) |
| fixed EUR field, USD tenant | en | `¥1,234.50` | `€1,234.50` |
| no currency anywhere | en | `¥1,234.50` | `1,234.50` |

A CNY tenant reads `CN¥1,234.50` in an English session and `¥1,234.50` in zh-CN: that is `Intl`'s symbol, as on every other currency face.

## Pins

- `formFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx`: the master-detail surface now declares a USD tenant and asserts the de/en grouping plus the resolved sign where the locale puts it (`1.234,50 $`, `$1,234.50`). The de/en difference and the no-machine-locale tripwire still run on it.
- New `MasterDetailForm.totalsCurrency-11132.test.tsx` (10 cases, one line of 1234.5 under a 10% tax rate, all three lines asserted together):
  - USD tenant: `$1,234.50` / `$123.45` / `$1,357.95`, once per resolve branch (fully configured, hydrated identity-only columns, derived);
  - fixed EUR field under a USD tenant: `€` on all three lines (hydrated and derived branches);
  - `currencyMode: 'dynamic'` with a `defaultCurrency` of EUR: the tenant's `$`, so the stack reads the field through the resolver's `currencyMode` rule (objectui#10422);
  - JPY tenant: `¥1,235` / `¥123` / `¥1,358`, the width change pinned;
  - de-DE: `1.234,50 $` / `123,45 $` / `1.357,95 $`;
  - no currency: `1,234.50` / `123.45` / `1,357.95`;
  - two entries resolving EUR and USD: plain numbers.

**Reverse verification (one-shot, not kept).** With the tests committed, `MasterDetailForm.tsx` was replaced by its blob at the branch point `db11afd49` (on-disk hash equal to that blob; the `¥` literal count went 0 to 1, `formatTotalsAmount` 3 to 0), and both pin files were run: 12 failed, 10 passed of 22. The 12 are all 10 new cases plus the two rewritten 9909 master-detail rows, each failing on the stack text (for example `¥1,234.50` received where `$1,234.50` was expected). Restored with `git checkout HEAD`, proven by the on-disk hash equal to the HEAD blob and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Acceptance notes

1. **Boundary: a fully configured entry reads the tenant's currency.** An entry with a relationship field and every column typed skips the child schema fetch, so no field definition is in hand and the stack resolves to the tenant default, even when the amount field fixes another currency. Every measured producer takes a fetching branch. Open question 2 in the report.
2. **Reach correction on the card.** The card names objectstack's `examples/app-showcase` invoice as the producer that switches the stack on. A render probe (not committed) of `MasterDetailForm` with the subform the console builds from that relationship (`relationshipField: 'invoice'`, identity-only `inlineColumns`, no `inlineAmountField`) and a `tax_rate` header rendered **no** `md-totals`: the hydrate branch of the resolve effect never derives an `amountField`. With `amountField: 'amount'` added, the stack renders. So the stack is reached where an entry carries an amount field (the spec's `inlineAmountField`, or derived when no `inlineColumns` are declared) under a `tax_rate` header. No example combines those two today: only the showcase invoice has `tax_rate`, and the CRM opportunity's line items declare `inlineAmountField` under a parent without one.
3. **Seen, not fixed here (reported to the seat).** That same hydrate branch skips the `sortField` derivation too. In the probe, a line created through the showcase-shaped subform carried no `position`, while the derived-branch control stamped `position: 0`.
4. **Line cells and stack can differ for a fixed-currency field.** `GridField` resolves a currency column against the tenant default only (its `columnCurrency` hands the resolver no field, by design). So under a fixed-EUR amount field in a USD tenant, the line cells read `$` while the stack now reads `€`, as the ruling asks. Before this change they read `$` and `¥`. Owner: none.
5. **Docs.** No page or README describes the stack's formatting: `taxRateField`, `Subtotal` and `tax_rate` have no hits in `packages/plugin-form/README.md` or in `content/docs` outside an unrelated formula example. Nothing to update.

No line this PR adds contains `any`. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`: type-aware linting is off, so this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file.
